section: Contractors: employee or self-employed, and withholding on payments to non-residents
label: Official test: employee or self-employed (Ministry of Manpower)
value: No single conclusive test; the actual relationship decides. Factors: control (who hires and dismisses, pays, sets the method and timing of work, provides the work), who owns the tools, equipment and workplace, and economic factors (own account, share in profit or risk of loss, how earnings are set)
note: Income Tax Act 1947, section 45: the payer withholds and pays the tax to IRAS. Tax treaties can lower or remove withholding; dividends are not subject to withholding.
source_title: Ministry of Manpower: What is a contract of service; FAQ: How do I know if I am engaged under a contract of service or contract for service? (both last updated 29 December 2025)

section: Contractors: employee or self-employed, and withholding on payments to non-residents
label: Self-employed persons
value: No employer-employee relationship: not covered by the Employment Act or the Work Injury Compensation Act, and no CPF contributions by the client; MOM's self-assessment tool helps decide
note: Income Tax Act 1947, section 45: the payer withholds and pays the tax to IRAS. Tax treaties can lower or remove withholding; dividends are not subject to withholding.
source_title: Ministry of Manpower: What is a contract of service; FAQ: How do I know if I am engaged under a contract of service or contract for service? (both last updated 29 December 2025)

section: Contractors: employee or self-employed, and withholding on payments to non-residents

note: Income Tax Act 1947, section 45: the payer withholds and pays the tax to IRAS. Tax treaties can lower or remove withholding; dividends are not subject to withholding.
source_title: Ministry of Manpower: What is a contract of service, Key terms of engagement template for self-employed persons (last updated 29 December 2025)
